scenes.title: Positive dynamics
scenes.summary: At a kitchen party celebrating Samsonov's official registration as a candidate for mayor, Samsonov sulks as Nina's polite lawyer friend Danya leaves, and Arkady flirts with Marina, taking her lack of feelings as a positive trend after her earlier disgust. Opening song.

scenes.title: Grandmother's brooch
scenes.summary: Searching for a vintage brooch to give Marina, Arkady argues with the imagined voice of his sharp-tongued late grandmother and waves off his legal consultation with lawyer Danya, who instead offers Nina pastries and tea in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Everyone talks, I act
scenes.summary: Under Ilona's direction, Samsonov personally paves a courtyard pothole with a hand roller for a TV report, then threatens a rude driver who complains about an uneven puddle.

scenes.title: Whose flowers are these?
scenes.summary: On the stairwell, Arkady snatches Eduard Valentinovich's bouquet from the flower courier, waves his own delivery receipt, and claims he and Marina are a couple until fed-up Marina throws both bouquets down the stairs.

scenes.title: Two days in Plyos
scenes.summary: Ilona tells Arkady that Samsonov's poll ratings have caught up with Osipenko's, while inside Marina's room Eduard explains his wife Alla Evgenyevna caught stomach flu last night and says he told her he is at a two-day symposium in Plyos so he and Marina can spend two days together.

scenes.title: The governor's trick
scenes.summary: Listening outside Marina's door, Arkady drops to his knees and kisses Ilona's boots — a trick he learned from the governor — until she agrees to help him break up Marina and Eduard, just as Eduard tells Marina he took a potency pill and a loud crash echoes from the stairs.

scenes.title: Fell down the stairs
scenes.summary: Staging a fall down the stairs while supposedly clearing cobwebs before inviting Marina for tea, Arkady pretends to be in agony without his glasses and begs Marina to ride with him to the hospital.

scenes.title: We lifted the barbell, we'll lift the region
scenes.summary: Learning that Samsonov's ratings have caught up with his and facing an ultimatum from the governor, Pasha suffers a blood-pressure spike to 210 over 139 and gets pinned under a heavy barbell while filming a campaign stunt.

scenes.title: Cheese fondue
scenes.summary: Coming home for the weekend with candy, Samsonov finds lawyer Danya playing a board game with Nina, Yulya, and Slavik, rudely chases him out, and argues with Nina when Slavik says Danya is bringing a cheese fondue set tomorrow.

scenes.title: Luntik 2018
scenes.summary: While a technician checks Colonel Mikhail Mikhailovich's computer (password 'Luntik 2018', budget graphics card for Counter-Strike), Lavrov and Ovechkin ask to search the archives for Samsonov's grandparents and are assigned Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov.

scenes.title: Mayor on his knees
scenes.summary: The hospital trauma doctor sees Arkady doesn't even have a bruise and refuses a bribe, until Arkady drops to his knees and kisses the doctor's shoes in the name of love, winning fake plaster casts on both arms.

scenes.title: He charmed you
scenes.summary: Waiting in the hospital corridor, jealous Eduard accuses Marina of being charmed by Arkady, then apologizes and suggests a summer café just as Arkady emerges with both arms encased in plaster casts.

scenes.title: This isn't the CIA
scenes.summary: Down in the dusty paper archive, Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov demands that Lavrov and Ovechkin ask General Kruglov to transfer him officially to their Moscow group, and storms out when they refuse and mock his height.

scenes.title: Where are the X-rays?
scenes.summary: Escorted home by Marina and Eduard with both arms in plaster casts, Arkady pretends he left his X-rays at the hospital and hugs Marina with his cast-clad arms to infuriate Eduard.

scenes.title: I am Sun Tzu
scenes.summary: Falling asleep over The Art of War, Samsonov dreams that ancient Chinese strategist Sun Tzu advises him to lure lawyer Danya onto his own territory using his airborne survival skills.

scenes.title: Stop rustling!
scenes.summary: At night, Arkady ruins Eduard's romantic plans by banging on the bedroom wall and shouting for quiet for a sick man, while Samsonov phones Danya to apologize and invite him over with his fondue tomorrow.
scenes.location: Marina's room / Arkady's room / Samsonov flat

scenes.title: Bodyguards, not body-breakers
scenes.summary: Pasha Osipenko orders his two bodyguards to stage a mugging and crack Samsonov's skull so he can't run for mayor, overcoming their Buddhist moral objections about ruining their karma by threatening to fire them.

scenes.title: Winter picnic in nature
scenes.summary: Over Danya's cheese fondue in the communal kitchen, Klavdia Viktorovna predicts Danya will marry Nina, prompting Samsonov to complain that fondue lacks broad Russian scale and invite everyone — including Danya — on a winter shashlik picnic in the forest.

scenes.title: Romantic breakfast
scenes.summary: The next morning, Arkady barges into Marina and Eduard's romantic breakfast with his casts, guilt-trips Marina into giving him a croissant, gets his cast slammed in the door, and announces he will go cook porridge.

scenes.title: Knee-deep ruts
scenes.summary: In the courtyard, Samsonov mocks Danya's small city car before setting off for the snowy forest.

scenes.title: Cooking porridge in casts
scenes.summary: In the communal kitchen, Marina and Eduard find Arkady dumping groats and milk everywhere while trying to cook porridge with both arms in plaster casts and slipping onto the floor.

scenes.title: In the forest, only firewood
scenes.summary: After Samsonov's car breaks down on the way to the forest and Danya's city car tows him in, Danya effortlessly outshines Samsonov with folding chairs and charcoal, so Samsonov marches the men into the woods for firewood.

scenes.title: Enjoy your porridge
scenes.summary: Back in the kitchen, Arkady apologizes for being a burden and provokes Eduard into storming out, leaving Marina to realize Arkady cannot hold a spoon with his casts.

scenes.title: The main thing is a lever
scenes.summary: Deep in the snowy forest looking for firewood, Samsonov boasts he will snap a dry branch using a lever trick and tumbles down into a ravine.

scenes.title: A spoonful for daddy, one for mommy
scenes.summary: Finding Marina spoon-feeding porridge to Arkady, Eduard takes over, gets taunted by Arkady about eavesdropping on his potency pill, dumps the hot porridge on Arkady's head, and gets kicked out by Marina when he claims Arkady is faking his broken arms.

scenes.title: Uncle Danya saved him
scenes.summary: Slavik and Danya bring a limping Samsonov back up from the ravine after Danya rescued him.

scenes.title: The rubber glove
scenes.summary: After washing off the porridge, Arkady claims he got so nervous that he urgently needs the bathroom and cannot manage his zipper with both arms in casts, forcing a mortified Marina to help him in a rubber dish glove with her back turned until she accidentally pinches him with the zipper.

scenes.title: Onion, salt, pepper
scenes.summary: At the forest grill after Danya rescues Samsonov from the ravine, everyone devours Danya's tender shashlik while Samsonov's tough market-marinated meat goes untouched.

scenes.title: I won't need this key anymore
scenes.summary: As Marina applies stinging antiseptic ointment to Arkady's pinched skin while he yells, Eduard walks in to apologize, misinterprets the scene, leaves his apartment key on the table, and breaks up with Marina forever.

scenes.title: You can't buy skill
scenes.summary: Showing off his airborne axe-throwing and high-kick skills at the forest picnic, Samsonov kicks the tree where the axe is stuck and knocks the axe straight down onto Danya's hand.

scenes.title: German archive sources
scenes.summary: On a video call with General Kruglov, Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov presents German archive documents proving Samsonov's maternal grandfather was a wartime collaborator near Bryansk, earning official assignment to Lavrov's team.

scenes.title: A blue flame flickered
scenes.summary: Slipping his arms out of his casts, Arkady gives Marina his grandmother's brooch and recites Yesenin's love poem, nearly winning a kiss until Ilona calls on speakerphone and exposes his fake injury, prompting Marina to beat him with his own cast.

scenes.title: A mark against him
scenes.summary: At the hospital trauma room surgeon Vakhtang Surenovich bandages Danya's injured finger while Samsonov apologizes, and at City Hall Lavrov delivers the wartime collaborator archive file to a delighted Pasha Osipenko.

scenes.title: We don't hit on the head
scenes.summary: After Nina and the kids walk home without Samsonov in disgust, Samsonov takes out his frustration on Pasha's two bodyguards when they try to hospitalize him, while Eduard's guitar serenade outside Marina's window is cut short when his wife calls from Plyos. Closing song.
